context: A mother brings in her child
purpose: Reassure a parent; teach 感染/拒否/対処/防衛/認定/形態/青年/実質

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 子どもが感染したかもしれません。
lines.en: My child may have caught an infection.
lines.style: anxious mother seeking help, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 検査を拒否しなければ、すぐ分かりますよ。
lines.en: If you don’t refuse the test, we’ll know soon.
lines.style: doctor offering a calm path, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: I want to deal with it quickly.
lines.style: worried mother urging speed, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 子どもの防衛力は意外と高いんです。
lines.style: reassuring doctor offering comfort, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 学校に、病気として認定してもらう必要は？
lines.en: Does the school need it certified as illness?
lines.style: practical mother asking procedure, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 軽い形態なら、その必要はありません。
lines.en: If it’s a mild form, there’s no need.
lines.style: doctor clarifying gently, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 上の子は、もう青年ですが、うつりますか？
lines.en: My older one is a young adult — could it spread?
lines.style: mother extending her concern, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 手洗いを徹底すれば、実質、心配いりません。
lines.en: With thorough handwashing, essentially no worry.
lines.style: doctor giving practical reassurance, tone holding steady through the whole line
